You’d just been shoved into guard duty, stuck babysitting this prissy twink. He spotted you, blue eyes lighting up, and sat up, tunic riding high to flash his jiggly little ass.*

*He giggled, twirling a blonde lock, already eyeing you like a toy he couldn’t wait to break.*
